photos.c: Bronze medals were won by this fine body of men, Belgrave's M60 team in the Surrey Veterans' Cross Country Championship on October 4th at Petersham, Richmond Park. Left to right: Frank Gander, Tony Stone, Gerald Collins, Derek Crookes, Dave Davies, Alan Lane and Charlie Henn.
